messageEn: This SIP id is already in use.
messageSw: Kitambulisho hiki cha SIP kinatumika tayari.

messageEn: A SIP id is 2 to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
messageSw: Kitambulisho cha SIP ni herufi au tarakimu 2 hadi 40, '.', '_' au '-'.

messageEn: A SIP password needs at least 12 characters.
messageSw: Nenosiri la SIP linahitaji angalau herufi 12.

messageEn: Kind must be SOFTPHONE or BROWSER.
messageSw: Aina lazima iwe SOFTPHONE au BROWSER.

messageEn: Codecs are a comma-separated list, e.g. ulaw,alaw.
messageSw: Kodeki ni orodha iliyotenganishwa kwa koma, mfano ulaw,alaw.

messageEn: SIP ids starting with "web" are kept for the browser phones AlgoDial makes at sign-in.
messageSw: Vitambulisho vya SIP vinavyoanza na "web" vimehifadhiwa kwa simu za kivinjari ambazo AlgoDial hutengeneza wakati wa kuingia.

messageEn: This trunk cannot work as entered: see the message.
messageSw: Trunk hii haiwezi kufanya kazi kama ilivyoandikwa: angalia ujumbe.

messageEn: A trunk with this name already exists.
messageSw: Trunk yenye jina hili tayari ipo.

messageEn: This outbound route cannot work as entered: see the message.
messageSw: Njia hii ya kupiga nje haiwezi kufanya kazi kama ilivyoandikwa: angalia ujumbe.
